remarks: Huge Potential meets Coastal Convenience at 28 County Street! Step into the perfect blend of style, space and location! This sun-splashed home offers an inviting layout with clean lines, modern kitchen updates and just the right touch of charm! Whether you're inside entertaining in the open, cozy family room, prepping dinner in the oversized kitchen, or outside unwinding on the private back deck, every inch will feel like home. Boasting 5 Bedrooms, plus an additional room and 2.5 baths, hardwood floors and central air. The additional upstairs rooms can easily be turned into an In-Law suite or massive Primary Suite. All just minutes from the vibrant Sono district, beaches, parks, MetroNorth and I-95. Don't miss your chance to own this house that is full of space and potential!!
